task: Predict ARID1A mutation status in colon adenocarcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. On H&E, ARID1A-mutant tumors may show mismatch repair-deficient or hypermutated morphology, including mucinous differentiation, dense lymphocytic infiltration, poor differentiation, and medullary growth.

classes.0: ARID1A-negative colon adenocarcinoma with more conventional gland-forming morphology and fewer lymphocyte-rich or mucinous features.
classes.1: ARID1A-positive colon adenocarcinoma with mucinous, poorly differentiated, medullary, or lymphocyte-rich morphology.
